proposals.title: CanonicalEncoder: ADR-009 document + minimal implementation with golden-byte tests
proposals.why_now: The CanonicalEncoder is the single gateway to every StateHash in the project. INV-01, INV-22, and CI gate step 5 all depend on it. FASE-1 acceptance criteria explicitly require 'ADR-009 escrito e o encoder implementado antes de qualquer hash de estado existir'. After 6 consecutive failures across tasks 0004–0007, the pattern is clear: each attempt grew in scope to address the latest review finding and thereby created new surface for the next rejection. This attempt must be narrower: write the ADR first specifying exactly which types are admitted (null, boolean, bigint, safe-integer number, string, plain object with string-keyed own enumerable data properties, Array, Uint8Array) and which are rejected (undefined, NaN, Infinity, -0, Symbol, class instances, functions), then implement precisely that contract, proven by golden-byte fixture tests that hard-code expected hex output rather than round-trip comparisons. No type it does not need. No adversarial coverage bolted on afterward.

proposals.title: Core branded arithmetic types: Money, Quantity, Price, Rate, Tick with division helpers
proposals.why_now: FASE-1 scope requires 'core completo. Aritmética inteira' as its first item. These types are prerequisites for the ledger, price generator, tick loop, and every downstream package. They are completely independent of the encoder, hash ADR, and RNG — no blocker exists. ADR-003 and ADR-004 specify them precisely: Money/Quantity/Price/Rate as branded bigint; Tick as branded safe-integer number; division helpers with explicit RoundingMode enum (TRUNCATE_TOWARD_ZERO, ROUND_HALF_UP, ROUND_HALF_EVEN). This is the lowest-risk FASE-1 task and should be assigned in parallel with the encoder attempt.

proposals.title: Write hash function ADR resolving DEFINIR from ADR-002
proposals.why_now: ADR-002 is TRAVADA and mandates 'precisa ser especificada bit a bit em ADR, e não pode ser a função de hash nativa da linguagem'. §19 lists 'função de hash' as an explicit DEFINIR item. Without this ADR, the positional rand() function cannot be implemented correctly, blocking the RNG and in turn the price generator. Writing the ADR is documentation-only with zero code changes, the lowest possible rejection risk, and immediate unblocking value. It can run in parallel with the encoder and arithmetic types.

proposals.title: Implement positional RNG: rand(masterSeed, namespace, ...coordinates) -> bigint
proposals.why_now: INV-02 — 'consultar price(asset, t) diretamente é igual a chegar em t avançando tick por tick' — is described by the spec as the most important test in the project. It depends entirely on the positional RNG. Every market namespace (market.trend, market.factor, market.regime, macro.schedule, bot.policy, venue.liquidity, etc.) derives from rand(). FASE-1 requires a price generator with two noise layers, which requires rand(). This task unblocks the price generator and the full tick loop. It depends only on the hash function ADR (IDEA-003).

warnings: Systematic encoder stall: six consecutive CanonicalEncoder attempts (TASK-0004 through TASK-0007 attempt-03) were all rejected. The failure pattern is consistent: each attempt added complexity to address the latest review finding, creating new surface area for the next rejection. A seventh attempt must be strictly narrower — admit only the types that appear in CICLO state, reject everything else with an explicit error code, and prove correctness with golden-byte fixtures that hard-code expected hex output rather than round-trip or adversarial tests.

32 consecutive heartbeat checkpoints with 0 accepted tasks represents a complete project stall spanning the entire 10.8-hour benchmark runtime. The five proposals above are all independent of each other (except IDEA-004 depending on IDEA-003). They must be assigned concurrently to different work slots, not sequentially. Assigning only the encoder retry and waiting for acceptance before starting arithmetic types reproduces the single-threaded bottleneck that caused this stall.

The spec at §14.6 states the installer must exist in FASE-1 and warns explicitly about discovering ABI and native module problems in the last week. After 10.8 hours with zero deliverables, this risk is now critical rather than theoretical. IDEA-005 (minimum installer) is independent of all domain logic and can be accepted first, producing the first tangible FASE-1 deliverable.

No ADRs have been written in docs/decisions/ despite zero implementation work. The hash function is listed as an explicit DEFINIR item in §19. Writing the hash function ADR (IDEA-003) requires no code and has near-zero rejection risk; deferring it further delays the entire RNG and price generator chain.
